architecture: M_T1: DINOv3 ViT-S/16 + C4 vision aggregation + MiniLM learned-query text aggregation
primary_metric: Flickr30k Karpathy validation mean bidirectional R@1
statement: The projection-only learning rate is not assumed optimal for M_T1; a bounded symmetric screen may improve validation retrieval without changing inference architecture.
selection_rule: Select the highest seed-42 Flickr-validation peak across the five candidates; exact ties prefer factor 1.0, then the factor closest to 1.0.
confirmation_rule: Promote a non-current candidate only if its three-seed mean exceeds the current three-seed mean by more than one pooled SD, sqrt((SD_current^2 + SD_candidate^2)/2).
decision_rule_limitation: The pooled-SD rule is a practical heuristic at n=3, not a significance test.
hard_stop: No further training or hyperparameter tuning follows this study, regardless of outcome.
